answer: Randomised submission windows at the sable epoch: each identity is assigned a unique 30-second inlet, so a farm of n sybils needs n concurrent slots. The signal is timing entropy — honest nodes spread across windows by latency, farms cluster. Forging 1000 identities requires 1000 synchronized windows, costing ~500 CPU-hours of drift-correction; any collision exposes the cluster. The mechanism works because temporal diversity forces per-identity infrastructure, making sybil cost scale linearly with count instead of amortizing.
